programmes.d: While the Civil War rages on, President Abraham Lincoln must undertake an even more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.

Three strangers earn their way into the team and take a keen interest in Murphy. As their interest in Murphy takes a deadly turn, he must use his emerging zombie qualities to save the rest of our heroes.
When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

Driven by a horde onto sacred Native American grounds, our Heroes find two distinct halves of the same tribe trying to survive two separate ways. The "zunami" is bearing down on them all and their very survival at stake.

Mech-bots, with even bigger and badder weapons than their predecessors, attempt to stop bio-mechanical monsters from descending on LA. But the monsters are strong too, leaving the pilots of the mech-bots scrambling to defeat the creatures.
In a mind bending finale, the secret of Warren's dream is unlocked when they reach their final destination, the "Black Rainbow" drone launch facility.

A race of alien robots has conquered the Earth and forced humanity underground. After three hundred years of domination, a small group of humans develop a plan to defeat the mechanical invaders in the ultimate battle between man and machine.
Warren must leave her new life behind and find her way to Newmerica, reuniting with Murphy and the other heroes, while discovering George is an old friend.
When a tour guide breaks into America's Most Haunted House, a bit of amateur ghost hunting with friends turns into more horror than they could have ever imagined.

Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.

Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!
Recently discovered footage from a lost military expedition exposes the horrifying truth about the genesis of life on earth.
Doc and Our Heroes are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working Barber Shop full of mysterious, and murderous, characters

Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.
A couple hires a live-in nanny, who soon starts showing her neglectfulness. However, the nanny established legal residency in the home, embarking the couple on a legal battle to reclaim their home.

programmes.d: Based on one of the true incidents that inspired THE EXORCIST, a psychiatrist suggests that the parents perform an actual Catholic exorcism on their daughter, who actually believes she is possessed.

After an alien spacecraft appears above Washington, D.C., a disparate band of residents in a small Connecticut town must fight off a unit of alien soldiers that is hunting for the President of the United States after his escape helicopter crashes.
A beautiful island's aquatic life faces a new terror: the 5-Headed Shark, a demented starfish-shaped monster threatening Puerto Rico's beaches
